messages:
carl.svensson: quick flag  found another missing diagram on canary: /images/diagram-cache/key-routing.png -> 404 when loading runbook. i think this one wasn't migrated during the asset consolidation.
doc-bot: automated-scan: 404 detected at /images/diagram-cache/key-routing.png (scan id 44556)
anya.kapoor: thanks Carl. can you paste the staging URL and curl?
carl.svensson: staging link: https://staging.redwood.inference/runbooks/cache-patterns
repro: 
```
$ curl -I https://staging.redwood.inference/runbooks/cache-patterns
HTTP/2 200
content-type: text/html; charset=utf-8
...
GET /images/diagram-cache/key-routing.png -> 404 Not Found
```
maria.nguyen: Owner in CODEOWNERS points to @docs-assets. For small rehost + markdown fix we usually do a docs PR to canary first. canary -> main after preview.
anya.kapoor: i'll take this. plan: 1) copy the svg from s3 (found under s3://docs-archive/diagrams/key-routing.svg) into docs/static/diagrams/, 2) update link in runbook to /static/diagrams/key-routing.svg, 3) improve alt text to "Key routing: KV cache + router" and add caption for search.
carl.svensson: sounds good. one note: please keep filename lowercase and hyphenated to avoid nginx path issues we saw last month.
anya.kapoor: will do. opening PR to canary for preview now.
doc-bot: scheduled re-scan after PR merged (scan id 44557)
anya.kapoor: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9134  copied asset + updated link + alt/caption. requesting review: @maria.nguyen @carl.svensson
maria.nguyen: quick review done 44d tiny suggestion: caption could include "batching & routing" to improve findability. otherwise lgtm pending preview.
anya.kapoor: updated caption in follow-up commit, ran `scripts/release-preview --canary`. staging render looks good. merging.
doc-bot: re-scan complete: /static/diagrams/key-routing.svg reachable (scan id 44558) :white_check_mark:
carl.svensson: awesome, thanks! adding item to docs-sprint board to sweep other diagrams under /images/diagram-cache to catch leftovers.
maria.nguyen: good call. i'll add a one-off CI check to flag /images/ paths that still exist in markdown for the sprint.
